steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ and open the Configuration for Event flow.
Provide the required event title for a create flow.
Apply the available RFQ pricing template before adding products.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.

args.goal: On the Single Stage RFQ create screen, open the Configuration for Event window, determine whether the unnamed checkbox label field is editable, and if it is editable type !@#$%^&*()_+{}|: into it and click Save; stop with the window closed if the value is accepted and saved, or with the inline invalid-character validation message visible if it is rejected.

steps.note: The configuration field has no catalog step or confirmed label, so this screen-driven step performs the conditional edit and observes the resulting save or validation behavior.
Confirm the resulting screen has no crash, server error, raw values, or malformed rendering after the Save attempt.
